Class ShipBoard

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.galaxy_trucker.server.model.ShipBoard
public class ShipBoard extends Object
Represents a 5x7 ship board on which Tile objects are placed.

Handles logic for tile placement, removal, crew and alien management, battery and shield systems, cargo handling, and strength calculations.

Each ship is initialized with a StartingCabinTile at the center and can be configured based on its BoardType.

    • getDefendingCannonType

      public ShipBoard.DefendingCannonType getDefendingCannonType(Projectile.Source source, int index)
      Determines the type of defending cannon available on the specified path.

      A single cannon is valid if it matches the direction. A double cannon is valid only if there is at least one battery and the cannon matches the direction.

      Parameters:
      source - The direction from which the attack is expected.
      index - The index of the path (column or row depending on direction).
      Returns:
      A ShipBoard.DefendingCannonType indicating whether the path has a single, double, or no cannon.
